wowhead_description: Path of Frost 1 Rune Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 27 Activates a freezing aura for 10 min that creates ice beneath your feet, allowing party or raid members within 50 yards to walk on water. Usable while mounted, but being attacked or damaged will cancel the effect.

Death and Decay 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant 30 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Death Knight Requires level 3 Corrupts the targeted ground, causing [(8.3% of Attack Power) * 11] Shadow damage over 10 sec to targets within the area. [ While you remain within the area, your Heart Strike will hit up to 0 additional targets.]
Chains of Ice 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 13 Shackles the target with frozen chains, reducing movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Death Coil 30 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 2 Fires a blast of unholy energy at the target, causing (211.812% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to an enemy or healing an Undead ally for (463.75% of Attack Power) health. Extends the duration of Dread Plague and Virulent Plague by 1.5 sec.

Death's Advance Instant 45 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Death Knight Requires level 9 For 10 sec, your movement speed is increased by 35%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks. Passive: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal speed.

Anti-Magic Shell Instant 1 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 14 Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell for 5 sec, absorbing up to [Total Health * 30 / 100 * (1 + Versatility) * 1 * 1 ] magic damage and preventing application of harmful magical effects. Damage absorbed generates Runic Power.
Lichborne Instant 2 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 9 Draw upon unholy energy to become Undead for 10 sec, increasing Leech by 6% and making you immune to Charm, Fear, and Sleep.

Death Grip 30 yd range Instant 25 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Death Knight Requires level 5 Harnesses the energy that surrounds and binds all matter, drawing the target toward you [ Blood : and forcing the enemy to attack you ] [ The cooldown is increased by 10 sec in PvP Combat.]

Death Gate 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 4 sec cast 1 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 10 Opens a gate which you can use to return to Ebon Hold. Using a Death Gate while in Ebon Hold will return you back to near your departure point.
On a Pale Horse Requires Death Knight Requires level 22 You are as hard to stop as death itself, increasing your mounted speed by 20%.

Rune of Razorice 5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Requires level 8 Engrave your weapon with a rune that causes [Max((0.01127 * Attack Power), 1)]% extra weapon damage as Frost damage and increases enemies' vulnerability to your Frost attacks by 3%, stacking up to 5 times. Modifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

Rune of the Fallen Crusader 5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Requires level 8 Engrave your weapon with a rune that has a chance to heal you for 4% of your maximum health and increase total Strength by 15% for 15 sec. Modifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.
Runeforging Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 6 Allows the Death Knight to emblazon their weapon with runes.
Blood Plague Unlimited range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 23 A shadowy disease that drains 64 health from the target over 24 sec.

Frost Fever Unlimited range Instant Requires Death Knight A disease that deals [(171.2% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.
Dark Command 30 yd range Instant 8 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 9 Command the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

Raise Ally 30 Runic Power 40 yd range Instant 10 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 19 Pours dark energy into a dead target, reuniting spirit and body to allow the target to reenter battle with 60% health and at least 20% mana.

Rune of the Stoneskin Gargoyle 5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Requires level 8 Engrave your weapon with a rune that increases Armor by 5% and all stats by 5%. Modifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.
Parry Requires Death Knight Requires Melee Weapon Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.
Corpse Exploder 30 yd range Instant 15 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 10 Cause a target corpse to explode in a shower of gore. Does not affect mechanical or elemental corpses.
Death Knight Requires Death Knight Modifies Critical Strike Damage 0%: Death Knight Frost Class Set 2pc , Frostscythe

Frost Breath 100 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Summons Sindragosa, who breathes frost on all enemies within 40 yd in front of you, dealing (420% of Attack Power) Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

Festering Wound Requires Death Knight Requires level 1 Festering Strike applies a pustulent lesion that will burst on death or when damaged by Scourge Strike, dealing (29.8063% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and generating 3 Runic Power. Stacks up to 0 times on any target.
Consumption Instant Requires Death Knight Strikes all enemies in front of you with a hungering attack that deals 87% Physical damage and heals you for 100% of that damage.
Val'kyr Unlimited range Requires Death Knight Your Summon Gargoyle spell summons a Val'kyr instead of a Gargoyle.

Rune Strike 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power Melee Range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 1 Requires Melee Weapon Strike the target for (60% of Attack Power) Physical damage. This attack cannot be dodged, blocked, or parried.

Rune of Sanguination 5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Requires level 32 Engrave your weapon with a rune that causes your Death Strike to deal increased damage based on the target's missing health. When you fall below 35% health, you heal for 48% of your maximum health over 8 sec. Modifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

Rune of Spellwarding 5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Requires level 48 Engrave your weapon with a rune that deflects 3% of all spell damage and taking magic damage has a chance to create a shield that absorbs magic damage equal to 10% of your maximum health. When an enemy damages the shield, their cast speed is reduced by 10% for 6 sec. Modifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

Rune of Unending Thirst 5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Requires level 20 Engrave your weapon with a rune that increases your movement speed by 5%. Additionally, when you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor you heal for 5% of your maximum health and gain 10% Haste and movement speed. Modifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

Rune of the Apocalypse 5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Requires level 44 Engrave your weapon with a rune that gives your ghoul's attacks a chance to apply one of the following debuffs to the target, Death: Healing Reduction, War: Increases damage taken from the Death Knight, Famine: Reduces damage dealt to the Death Knight, Pestilence: Slows the target and deals damage over time. Modifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.
Death's Advance Requires Death Knight Requires level 49 Death's Advance movement speed increased by 5% and the duration is increased by 2 sec.
Dual Wield Allows one-hand and off-hand weapons to be equipped in the off-hand.

Raise Dead 30 yd range Instant 30 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Raises [ Sludge Belcher : an Abomination ] [ Glyph of the Geist : a Geist / a Ghoul ] to fight by your side. You can have a maximum of one [ Sludge Belcher : Abomination ] [ Glyph of the Geist : Geist / Ghoul ] at a time.
Runic Corruption Requires Death Knight Requires level 11 Each Runic Power you spend has a 2.0% chance to increase your Rune regeneration rate by 100 % for 3 sec.
Rime Requires Death Knight Requires level 21 Frost Strike and Glacial Advance have a 45% chance to cause your next Howling Blast to consume no runes and deal 275% additional damage.

Mastery: Blood Shield Requires Death Knight Requires level 10 Each time you heal yourself with Death Strike, you gain 16.0% of the amount healed as a Physical damage absorption shield, up to 50% of you maximum health. Also increases your attack power by 8.0%.
Mastery: Frozen Heart Requires Death Knight Requires level 10 Increases the damage of your Frost abilities by 16.0%.

Mastery: Dreadblade Requires Death Knight Requires level 10 Increases the damage of your Minions and Shadow damage abilities by 14.0%. Increases the critical strike damage of your Minions and Diseases by 2.0%.

Crimson Scourge Requires Death Knight Requires level 21 Your auto attacks on targets infected with your Blood Plague have a chance to make your next Death and Decay cost no runes and reset its cooldown. (Proc chance: 25%)
Runic Empowerment Requires Death Knight Requires level 11 Each Runic Power you spend has a 1.8% chance to instantly grant you a Rune.

Might of the Frozen Wastes Requires Death Knight Requires level 25 Wielding a two-handed weapon increases Obliterate damage by 30%, Frostscythe damage by 30%, and your auto attack critical strikes always grant Killing Machine.

Festering Strike 2 Runes Melee Range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 10 Slash the enemy for (202.5% of Attack Power) Physical damage and corrupt your weapon with blight, causing your next 2-3 Scourge Strikes to summon a Lesser Ghoul. Lesser Ghoul A mindless servant of the Scourge, raised to obey its master's commands for 6 sec.
Plate Specialization Requires Death Knight Requires level 27 Requires Belt, Boots, Bracers, Chest, Chest, Gloves, Helms, Pants, Shoulders Increases your Strength by 5% while wearing only Plate armor.
Plate Specialization Requires Death Knight Requires level 27 Requires Belt, Boots, Bracers, Chest, Chest, Gloves, Helms, Pants, Shoulders Increases your Strength by 5% while wearing only Plate armor.
Plate Specialization Requires Death Knight Requires level 27 Requires Belt, Boots, Bracers, Chest, Chest, Gloves, Helms, Pants, Shoulders Increases your Stamina by 5% while wearing only Plate armor.

Riposte Requires Death Knight Requires level 29 You gain Parry equal to 100% of your Critical Strike from gear.

Dark Succor Requires Death Knight Requires level 18 When you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor, your next Death Strike within 20 sec is free and heals for an additional 10% of maximum health.

Death's Caress 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant 6 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 23 Reach out with necrotic tendrils, dealing (43.74% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and applying Blood Plague to your target and generating 2 Bone Shield charges. Epidemic 30 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 18 Causes each of your Virulent Plagues to flare up, dealing (62.5522% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to the infected enemy and (25.0212% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to foes nearby. Extends the duration of Dread Plague and Virulent Plague by 1.5 sec.

Army of the Dead Talent 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power Instant 1.5 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Summons a legion of 8 empowered Lesser Ghouls that last for 15 sec [ Raise Abomination : and an Abomination ] [ Summon Gargoyle : and a Gargoyle ] to swarm your enemies. Generates 40 Runic Power.

Raise Dead Talent 30 yd range Instant 2 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Raises a [ Glyph of the Geist : geist / ghoul] to fight by your side. You can have a maximum of one [ Glyph of the Geist : geist / ghoul] at a time. Lasts 1 min.

Mind Freeze Talent 15 yd range Instant 15 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

Empower Rune Weapon Talent 30 yd range Instant 30 sec recharge 2 Charges Requires Death Knight Drain the will of your enemy to empower your rune weapon, dealing (200% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage and reduced damage to enemies nearby, gaining 40 Runic Power, and grants you Killing Machine.
Veteran of the Third War Talent Requires Death Knight Frost, Unholy Stamina increased by 12%. Blood Stamina increased by 20%.

Death Pact Talent Instant 2 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 45 (Blood) Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.
Icebound Fortitude Talent Instant 2 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

Obliterate Talent 2 Runes Melee Range Instant Requires Death Knight A brutal attack [that deals [(105.751% of Attack Power)] Physical and [(105.751% of Attack Power)] Frost damage.][with both weapons that deals a total of [((71.4357% of Attack Power) + (71.4357% of Attack Power))] Physical and [((71.4357% of Attack Power) + (71.4357% of Attack Power))] Frost damage.]

Dancing Rune Weapon Talent 30 yd range Instant 2 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires Melee Weapon Summons a rune weapon for 8 sec that mirrors your melee attacks and bolsters your defenses. While active, you gain 20 % parry chance.

Frost Strike Talent 35 Runic Power Melee Range Instant Requires Death Knight Chill your [weapon with icy power and quickly strike the enemy, dealing [(114.834% of Attack Power)] Frost damage.][weapons with icy power and quickly strike the enemy with both, dealing a total of [(80.7582% of Attack Power) + (80.7582% of Attack Power)] Frost damage.]

Howling Blast Talent 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Blast the target with a frigid wind, dealing [(22.0356% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] [ Northrend Winds : Frost damage and applying Frost Fever to the target / Frost damage to that foe, and reduced damage to all other enemies within 10 yards, infecting all targets with Frost Fever.] Frost Fever A disease that deals [(171.2% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.

Summon Gargoyle Talent 30 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 50 Army of the Dead now summons a Gargoyle into the battlefield to bombard your enemies for 25 sec. The Gargoyle gains 1% increased damage for every 1 Runic Power you spend and always critically strikes.
Sudden Doom Talent Requires Death Knight Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.

Death Strike Talent 45 Runic Power Melee Range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires Melee Weapon Blood, Unholy Focuses dark power into a strike that deals (153.12% of Attack Power) Physical damage and heals you for (20 / Voracious : 21 / Improved Death Strike : 32 )% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0 % of maximum health. Frost Focuses dark power into a strike with both weapons, that deals a total of [(153.12% of Attack Power) + (29.835% of Attack Power)] Physical damage and heals you for (20 / Voracious : 21 / Improved Death Strike : 32 )% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0 % of maximum health.

Blood Boil Talent Instant 7.5 sec recharge 2 Charges Requires Death Knight Deals (164% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and infects all enemies within 10 yds with Blood Plague. Blood Plague A shadowy disease that drains 64 health from the target over 24 sec.
Anti-Magic Zone Talent 30 yd range Instant 4 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec , reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.

Killing Machine Talent Requires Death Knight Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to make your next Obliterate deal Frost damage and critically strike, or make your next Frostscythe critically strike for 4 times the normal damage.
Pillar of Frost Talent Instant 45 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight The power of frost increases your Strength by 30% for 12 sec.

Scourge Strike Talent 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight An unholy strike that deals (135% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness. Spreads Virulent Plague on the target to a nearby enemy.
Vampiric Blood Talent Instant 1.5 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Embrace your undeath, increasing your maximum health by 30% and increasing all healing and absorbs received by 30 % for 10 sec .
Horn of Winter Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 25 When use all your Runes you blow the Horn of Winter, gaining 2 Runes. Can only occur every 45 sec. (100ms cooldown)

Outbreak Talent 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague. Dread Plague A malicious plague that deals (439.11% of Attack Power) Shadow damage over 24 sec. Explodes for (184.5% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time. Virulent Plague An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing (200.35% of Attack Power) Shadow damage over 24 sec.

Asphyxiate Talent 20 yd range Instant 45 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 30 (Frost, Unholy) Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 4 sec.

Gorefiend's Grasp Talent 30 yd range Instant 1.5 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Shadowy tendrils coil around all enemies within 15 yards of a hostile or friendly target, pulling them to the target's location and Silencing them for 3 sec.
Control Undead Talent 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range 1.5 sec cast Requires Death Knight Dominates the target undead creature up to level 38, forcing it to do your bidding for 5 min.

Purgatory Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 50 An unholy pact that prevents fatal damage, instead absorbing incoming healing equal to the damage prevented, lasting 3 sec. If any healing absorption remains when this effect expires, you will die. This effect may only occur every 4 min.

Unholy Blight Talent 100 yd range Instant 45 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 25 Dark Transformation surrounds your ghoul with a vile swarm of insects for 6 sec, stinging all nearby enemies and infecting them with Virulent Plague and an unholy disease that deals (27.832% of Attack Power) damage over 14 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

Breath of Sindragosa Talent 16 Runic Power per sec Instant 2 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 50 Continuously deal [(139.788% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you, until your Runic Power is exhausted. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets. Generates 1 Rune at the start and end.

Defile Talent Replaces Death and Decay 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Instant 30 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Death Knight Requires level 45 Defile the targeted ground, dealing [((15% of Attack Power) * (11))] Shadow damage to all enemies over 10 sec . Every sec, if any enemies are standing in the Defile, it grows in size and deals increased damage.
Rapid Decomposition Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 25 Your Blood Plague and Death and Decay deal damage 15% more often. Additionally, your Blood Plague leeches 50% more Health.

Bonestorm Talent Instant 1 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 50 Consume up to 5 Bone Shield charges to create a whirl of bone and gore that batters all nearby enemies, dealing (65% of Attack Power) Shadow damage every 1 sec, and healing you for 2% of your maximum health every time it deals damage (up to 10%). Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. Lasts 2 sec per Bone Shield charge spent and rapidly regenerates a Bone Shield every 1 sec.
Icy Talons Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 15 Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times. (500ms cooldown)

Frozen Pulse Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 35 While you have fewer than 3 full Runes, your auto attacks radiate intense cold, inflicting (4.815% of Attack Power) Frost damage on all nearby enemies.
Gathering Storm Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 45 Each Rune spent during Remorseless Winter increases its damage by 10%, and extends its duration by 0.5 sec.

Glacial Advance Talent / Specialization 35 Runic Power 100 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 45 (Frost) Summon glacial spikes from the ground that advance forward, each dealing [(63.4275% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Frost damage near their eruption point and applying Razorice.

All Will Serve Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 15 Raise Dead summons an additional skeletal archer at your command that shoots Blighted Arrows. Blighted Arrow An unholy arrow that deals (34% of Attack Power) Shadow damage. When consuming Sudden Doom, your Death Coil commands your archer to fire an additional Blighted Arrow at 80 % effectiveness. Epidemic will instead cause Blighted Arrow to ricochet and hit up to 5 additional targets.
Pestilent Pustules Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 35 Bursting a Festering Wound has a 10% chance to grant you Runic Corruption.

Marrowrend Talent 2 Runes / -20 Runic Power Melee Range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires Melee Weapon Smash the target, dealing (147.1% of Attack Power) Physical damage and generating 3 charges of Bone Shield. Bone Shield Surrounds you with a barrier of whirling bones, increasing Armor by (150 * Strength / 100) [ Marrowrend : and your Haste by 0% ]. Each melee attack against you consumes a charge. Lasts 30 sec or until all charges are consumed.

Bloodworms Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 45 Approximately 5 procs per minute Your auto attacks have a chance to summon a Bloodworm. Bloodworms deal minor damage to your target for 15 sec and then burst, healing you for 15% of your missing health. If you drop below 50% health, your Bloodworms will immediately burst and heal you.
Red Thirst Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 50 Reduces the cooldown on Vampiric Blood by 2.0 sec per 10 Runic Power spent.
Anti-Magic Barrier Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 35 Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.

Heart Strike Talent 1 Rune / -15 Runic Power Melee Range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires Melee Weapon Instantly strike the target and 1 other nearby enemy, causing (157.334% of Attack Power) Physical damage, and reducing enemies' movement speed by 20% for 8 sec [ Heart Strike : Generates 5 bonus Runic Power ] [ Heartbreaker : plus 2 Runic Power per additional enemy struck ].

Blooddrinker Talent 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power 30 yd range Channeled (3 sec cast) 30 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 15 Drains 9 health from the target over 3 sec. The damage they deal to you is reduced by 15% for the duration and 5 sec after channeling it fully. You can move, parry, dodge, and use defensive abilities while channeling this ability. Generates 20 additional Runic Power over the duration.

Mark of Blood Talent 15 yd range Instant 6 sec cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 35 Places a Mark of Blood on an enemy for 15 sec. The enemy's damaging auto attacks will also heal their victim for 3% of the victim's maximum health.
Will of the Necropolis Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 35 Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.
Tightening Grasp Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 40 Gorefiend's Grasp cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and it now also Silences enemies for 3 sec.
Foul Bulwark Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 30 Each charge of Bone Shield increases your maximum health by 1%.

Shattering Blade Talent Requires Death Knight When Frost Strike damages an enemy with 5 stacks of Razorice it will consume them to deal an additional 115% damage. Frostbane consumes the Razorice on your main target to deal an additional 300% damage.
Murderous Efficiency Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 25 Consuming the Killing Machine effect has a 20% chance to grant you 1 Rune.
Runic Attenuation Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 25 Approximately 10.8 procs per minute Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
Icecap Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 50 Reduces Pillar of Frost cooldown by 15 sec. (500ms cooldown)

Avalanche Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 35 Casting Howling Blast with Rime active causes jagged icicles to fall on enemies nearby your target, applying Razorice and dealing (22.47% of Attack Power) Frost damage.

Blinding Sleet Talent Instant 1 min cooldown Requires Death Knight Requires level 30 Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect. When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
Permafrost Talent Requires Death Knight Requires level 40 Frost, Unholy Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 30% of the damage dealt.

Frostscythe Talent 2 Runes 8 yd range Instant Requires Death Knight Requires level 35 A sweeping attack that strikes all enemies in front of you for (40% of Attack Power) Frost damage. Refining Fire Talent Unlimited range Requires Paladin Enemies struck by Avenger's Shield burn with holy fire, suffering 100% additional Radiant damage over 5 sec.

Authoritative Rebuke Talent 40 yd range Requires Paladin Holy Successfully dispelling a harmful effect reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1.0 sec. Effect increased by 100% while wielding a Holy Armament. Protection Successfully interrupting an enemy spellcast reduces Rebuke's cooldown by 1.0 sec. Effect increased by 100% while wielding a Holy Armament. (100ms cooldown)

Pillars of Light Talent Requires Paladin Beacon of Faith : Allies with Beacon of Light or Beacon of Faith are healed for (33% of Spell Power) every 3 sec. Beacon of Virtue : Beacon of Virtue instantly heals allies for (390.625% of Spell Power).

Tyr's Deliverance Talent Requires Paladin Activating Avenging Wrath releases the Light within yourself, healing 5 injured allies instantly and an injured ally every 1 sec within 40 yds for (35.1% of Spell Power). Allies healed also receive 10% increased healing from your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells for 12 sec.

Hammer of Wrath Talent Requires Paladin Holy, Protection During Avenging Wrath, Judgment is empowered into Hammer of Wrath. Hammer of Wrath Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for [(123.75% of Attack Power) * 1 ] [ Blades of Light : Holystrike / Holy] damage. Generates 1 Holy Power. Retribution During Avenging Wrath, Judgment is empowered into Hammer of Wrath. Hammer of Wrath Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for [(143.871% of Attack Power) * 1 ] Holy damage. Generates 1 Holy Power.
Empyrean Legacy Talent Requires Paladin Judgment critical strikes empower your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn at 30% effectiveness.

Call of the Righteous Talent Requires Paladin Avenging Wrath's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, but its duration is reduced by 5.0 sec. Avenging Crusader's cooldown is reduced by 30.0 sec, but its duration is reduced by 3.0 sec.
Ringing of the Heavens Talent Requires Paladin Activating Aura Mastery also casts a Divine Toll at 100% effectiveness. (500ms cooldown)
Seraphic Barrier Talent Requires Paladin Word of Glory and Light of Dawn now convert 15% of their healing into an absorb shield instead.
Glistening Radiance Talent Requires Paladin While at maximum health, targets with Beacon of Light generate an absorb shield equal to 1% of their health every 3 sec, up to a maximum of 5%.
Blessing of Dusk Talent Requires Paladin Damage taken reduced by up to 10%, increasing as your health decreases.
Vengeful Wrath Talent Requires Paladin Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.

Hand of Divinity Talent Requires Paladin Activating Avenging Wrath calls upon the Light to empower you, causing your next [ Avenging Crusader : Holy Light / 2 Holy Lights] to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.
Undying Embers Talent Unlimited range Requires Paladin You are healed for 100% of the damage dealt by Refining Fire.
Searing Sunlight Talent Unlimited range Requires Paladin Casting Avenger's Shield causes Consecration to deal its damage and healing again immediately at 100% effectiveness.

Beacon of the Savior Talent Requires Paladin While in combat, apply a Beacon of the Savior to the lowest health ally within 30 yds that causes your direct healing on others to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed. Beacon of the Savior transfers to the lowest health ally within 30 yds if it heals a target past maximum health or if an ally drops below 50% health.
Vision of Sanctity Talent Unlimited range Requires Paladin Consecration deals 100% increased damage when it strikes a single target.
Beacon of the Savior Talent Requires Paladin Beacon of the Savior transfers an additional 10% of the amount healed and allies with Beacon of the Savior receive 10% more healing from you.

Beacon of the Savior Talent Requires Paladin Every 8 sec or when Beacon of the Savior transfers to a new injured target, they are granted an absorb shield that prevents the next 0 damage and reduces damage taken by 10% for 15 sec.
Solace Talent Unlimited range Requires Paladin Consecration heals you for 300% of the damage it deals.
Valiant Crusade Talent Unlimited range Requires Paladin While out of combat, Divine Steed grants Shield of the Righteous for its duration and an additional 4.0 sec after it fades.
Empyrean Authority Talent Requires Paladin Guardian of Ancient Kings has 1 additional charge.
Sweeping Verdict Talent Requires Paladin Judgment chains to 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
Crusade Talent Requires Paladin Avenging Wrath now grants you 2% Haste. Each Holy Power spent during Avenging Wrath increases Haste by an additional 2%, up to 20%.
Divine Exaction Talent Requires Paladin Divine Toll casts 2 additional times on your target at 150% effectiveness.
Light Within Talent Requires Paladin Avenging Wrath further increases the damage of [ Final Verdict / Templar's Verdict] and Divine Storm by 10%.
Light Within Talent Requires Paladin [ Righteous Cause / Art of War] increases the damage of your next Blade of Justice by 150%.

Light Within Talent Requires Paladin [ Righteous Cause / Art of War] further empowers Blade of Justice to unleash a wave of Holy energy, dealing [(442.557% of Attack Power) * 2.5] Holy damage to its primary target and (442.557% of Attack Power) Holy damage to all other enemies in its path.

Light's Judicator Talent Requires Paladin Empyrean Hammer deals 20% increased critical strike damage and its critical strikes have 50% chance to grant an additional stack of Light's Deliverance. (Proc chance: 50%)

Shield of Vengeance Talent Requires Paladin Divine Protection reduces damage taken by an additional 10% and casts Shield of Vengeance. Shield of Vengeance Creates a barrier of holy light that absorbs [30 / 100 * Total Health * (1 + Versatility)] damage for 10 sec. When the shield expires, it bursts to inflict Holy damage equal to the total amount absorbed, divided among all nearby enemies.
Seal of the Templar Talent Requires Paladin Retribution damage increased by 25%. Protection Judgment damage increased by 30%.

Walk Into Light Talent Requires Paladin Retribution You have a 100% chance to gain Blessing of An'she and generate 2 Holy Power after casting Avenging Wrath. During Avenging Wrath, Hammer of Wrath casts Blade of Justice at 100% effectiveness. Holy You have a 100% chance to generate 2 Holy Power after casting Avenging Wrath. (1s cooldown)

Endless Gleam Talent Requires Paladin Retribution Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.3 sec whenever struck by Divine Storm or Templar's Verdict. When 2 Dawnlights are struck by Divine Storm, their durations are extended by an additional 0.3 sec. Holy Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.5 sec when it heals an ally with full health.
Born in Sunlight Talent Requires Paladin Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath. (1s cooldown)
Fear No Evil Talent Requires Paladin Fear duration on you reduced by 20%. This effect is increased to 60% during Avenging Wrath.

Brought to Light Talent Requires Paladin Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor causes you to explode with holy energy, healing up to 5 nearby allies and yourself for (500% of Attack Power), split evenly among them.

Glory of the Vanguard Talent Requires Paladin Judgment has a chance to grant you Vanguard, causing your next Avenger's Shield to leave an echoing bolt of light in a line between you and the initial target, piercing any enemies for (300% of Attack Power) Holy damage.
Glory of the Vanguard Talent Requires Paladin Judgment deals 10% increased damage. When you consume Vanguard you gain 1 Holy Power.

Glory of the Vanguard Talent Requires Paladin Your next cast of Shield of the Righteous after Vanguard deals 50% additional damage to your primary target and causes light to refract onto 4 other targets for (200% of Attack Power) Holy damage. During Avenging Wrath your Avenger's Shield always benefits from Vanguard.
Divine Favor Talent Requires Paladin The mana cost of Holy Light is reduced by 10% and its cast time is reduced by 15%.
Seek Deliverance Talent Requires Paladin While Avenging Wrath is not active, you gain 5% Mastery. While Avenging Wrath is active, you gain 30% movement speed.
Divine Overload Talent Requires Paladin Holy Light's healing is increased by 30%, but its mana cost is increased by 20%.
Unending Light Talent Requires Paladin Light of Dawn receives 20% increased benefit from Mastery: Lightbringer.
Masterwork Talent Requires Paladin After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 abilities cast a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.

Reflection of Radiance Talent Requires Paladin Holy When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Awakening. Protection When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Grand Crusader.
Resounding Strike Talent Requires Paladin Protection Divine Toll activates Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness. Holy Holy Armaments activate Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.
Imbued Shield Talent Requires Paladin Shield of the Righteous reduces magical damage taken by 10%.
Adjudication Talent Requires Paladin Judgment causes its primary target's successful melee attacks against you to grant a Physical absorb shield for 20% of the damage dealt. Limit 1.
Instrument of the Divine Talent Requires Paladin Shield of the Righteous consumes up to 2 more Holy Power and deals 50% increased damage for each additional Holy Power consumed.

Armory of Light Talent Requires Paladin While holding a shield, you have a 15% chance to block incoming spells, reducing their damage by 20%. Without a shield, you have a 15% chance to parry incoming melee attacks, reducing their damage by 20%.
Rising Sunlight Talent Requires Paladin Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the average health percentage of allies with your Beacon of Light.
Power Word: Shield 10% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 7.5 sec cooldown Requires Priest Requires level 4 Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 0 damage.

Mind Soothe 1% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 5 sec cooldown Requires Priest Requires level 18 Soothes enemies in the target area, reducing the range at which they will detect you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid and Dragonkin targets. Does not cause threat. Lasts 20 sec.

Smite 3% of base mana 40 yd range 1.5 sec cast Requires Priest Requires level 1 Smites an enemy for (98.7% of Spell Power) Holy damage [ Sanctuary : and absorbs the next [(Shadow spell power * 180 / 100) * (1 + Versatility)] damage dealt by the enemy ] [ Holy Fire : and has a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Holy Fire ].

Shadow Word: Pain 2% of base mana 40 yd range Instant Requires Priest Requires level 2 Discipline, Holy A word of darkness that causes (16.8% of Spell Power) Shadow damage instantly, and an additional (99.68% of Spell Power) Shadow damage over 16 sec. Shadow A word of darkness that causes (16.8% of Spell Power) Shadow damage instantly, and an additional (99.68% of Spell Power) Shadow damage over 16 sec. Generates 3 Insanity.

Levitate 0.9% of base mana 30 yd range Instant Requires Priest Requires level 12 Levitates a party or raid member for 10 min, floating a few feet above the ground, granting slow fall, and allowing travel over water.

Flash Heal 10% of base mana 40 yd range 1.5 sec cast Requires Priest Requires level 3 A fast spell that heals an ally for (682% of Spell Power).

Mind Vision 1% of base mana Unlimited range Channeled (1 min cast) Requires Priest Requires level 14 Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

Power Word: Fortitude 1% of base mana 40 yd range Instant Requires Priest Requires level 6 Infuses the target with vitality, increasing their Stamina by 5% for 1 hour. If the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

Focused Will Requires Priest Requires level 16 Melee attacks against you cause you to gain Focused Will, reducing [ Shadow : magic damage you take by 5% and physical damage you take by 15% for 8 sec / Discipline, Holy damage you take by 15% for 8 sec ] Discipline, Holy stacking up to 1 times
Soul Warding Requires Priest Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield ability by 2 sec.

Void Volley Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for (106.049% of Spell Power) Shadow damage. Generates 10 Insanity.

Void Bolt Requires Priest Requires level 23 For the duration of Voidform, your Void Eruption ability is replaced by Void Bolt: Void Bolt 40 yd range Instant 6 sec cooldown Requires Priest Requires level 23 Sends a bolt of pure void energy at the enemy, causing (350.975% of Spell Power) Shadow damage . Requires Voidform. Generates 10 Insanity.

Mind Flay 40 yd range Channeled (4.5 sec cast) Requires Priest Requires level 10 Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing (720.72% of Spell Power) Shadow damage over 4.5 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. Generates 18 Insanity over the duration.

Silence 40 yd range Instant 30 sec cooldown Requires Priest Requires level 26 Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec. Against non-players, also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

Prayer of Mending 10% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 12 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Priest Requires level 11 Places a ward on an ally that heals them for (61% of Spell Power) the next time they take damage, and then jumps to another ally within 30 yds. Jumps up to 4 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump.

Vampiric Touch 40 yd range 1.5 sec cast Requires Priest Requires level 10 A touch of darkness that causes 49 Shadow damage over 21 sec, and heals you for 30% of damage dealt. If Vampiric Touch is dispelled, the dispeller flees in Horror for 3 sec. Generates 4 Insanity.

Castable while moving. When you heal with Penance, everyone with your Atonement is healed for (18.72% of Spell Power).

Increases movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to all movement impairing effects. Castable while stunned, feared, or silenced.

Dispel Magic Talent 14% of base mana 30 yd range Instant Requires Priest Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.
Fade Talent Instant 30 sec cooldown Requires Priest Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.
Prayer of Healing Talent 5.25% of base mana 40 yd range 2.5 sec cast Requires Priest A powerful prayer that heals your target and 4 injured allies within 40 yards for (578.742% of Spell Power).

Mind Control Talent 2% of base mana 30 yd range 1.8 sec cast Requires Priest Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec. Does not work versus Demonic , Undead, or Mechanical beings. Shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

Holy Word: Serenity Talent 2.375% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 1 min cooldown 1 Charge Requires Priest Perform a miracle, healing an ally for (1787.44% of Spell Power). Cooldown reduced by 6 sec when you cast Flash Heal .

Mind Blast Talent 4% of base mana 40 yd range 1.5 sec cast 9 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Priest Holy Blast the target's mind for (78.336% of Spell Power) Shadow damage. Discipline Blast the target's mind for (78.336% of Spell Power) Shadow damage. Costs a high amount of mana. Shadow Blast the target's mind for (78.336% of Spell Power) Shadow damage. Generates 6 Insanity.

Psychic Scream Talent 1.2% of base mana Instant 40 sec cooldown Requires Priest Lets out a psychic scream, causing all enemies within 8 yards to flee, disorienting them for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

Shackle Horror Talent 1.2% of base mana 30 yd range 1.5 sec cast Requires Priest Shackles an aberration or undead enemy for 50 sec, preventing all actions and movement. Damage will cancel the effect. Limit 1.
Power Infusion Talent 40 yd range Instant 2 min cooldown Requires Priest Infuses the target with power for 15 sec, increasing haste by 20%. Can only be cast on players.

Holy Fire Talent 0.24% of base mana 40 yd range 1.5 sec cast 10 sec cooldown Requires Priest Consumes the enemy in Holy flames that cause (308% of Spell Power) Holy damage and an additional (98.91% of Spell Power) Holy damage over 7 sec.
Desperate Prayer Talent Instant 1.5 min cooldown Requires Priest Increases maximum health by [ Light's Inspiration : 35 / 25]% for 10 sec, and instantly heals you for that amount.

Mass Dispel Talent 20% of base mana 30 yd range 1.5 sec cast 2 min cooldown Requires Priest Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing all harmful Magic from 5 friendly targets and 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemy targets. Potent enough to remove Magic that is normally undispellable.

Shadow Word: Death Talent 0.5% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 10 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Priest Discipline, Holy A word of dark binding that inflicts (85% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health. Damage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health. Shadow A word of dark binding that inflicts (85% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health. Damage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health. Generates 1 Insanity.
Pain Suppression Talent 1.6% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 3 min cooldown 1 Charge Requires Priest Reduces all damage taken by a friendly target by 40 % for 8 sec. Castable while stunned.

Shadowfiend Talent Requires Priest Discipline Shadow Word: Death has a 100% chance to summon a Shadowfiend for 5 sec when damaging targets below 20% health. Shadowfiend Summons a Shadowfiend to attack your target for 5 sec. Generates 0.1% mana each time the Shadowfiend attacks. Shadow Shadow Word: Death has a 40% chance to summon a Shadowfiend for 5 sec when damaging targets below 20% health. Shadowfiend Summons a Shadowfiend to attack your target for 5 sec. Generates 1 Insanity each time the Shadowfiend attacks.

Holy Word: Sanctify Talent 3.325% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 1 min cooldown 1 Charge Requires Priest Releases miraculous light at a target location, healing up to 5 allies within 10 yds for (501.101% of Spell Power). Cooldown reduced by 6 sec when you cast Prayer of Healing.
Divine Aegis Talent Requires Priest Direct critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 30% of the amount healed. Lasts 15 sec.

Guardian Spirit Talent 0.9% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 3 min cooldown Requires Priest Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target for 10 sec , increasing healing received by 60%. If the target would die, the Spirit sacrifices itself and restores the target to 40% health. Castable while stunned. Cannot save the target from massive damage.
Petrifying Scream Talent Requires Priest Psychic Scream causes enemies to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear. Modifies Effect #2's Value -4: Pandemonium , Psychic Scream

Power Word: Barrier Talent 4% of base mana 40 yd range Instant 3 min cooldown Requires Priest Summons a holy barrier to protect all allies at the target location for 10 sec, reducing all damage taken by 20% and preventing damage from delaying spellcasting.
Psychic Horror Talent 30 yd range Instant 45 sec cooldown Requires Priest Requires level 35 Terrifies the target in place, stunning them for 4 sec.

Body and Soul Talent Requires Priest Requires level 25 (Holy) Discipline, Shadow Power Word: Shield and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec. Holy Prayer of Mending and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec.

Divine Hymn Talent 4.4% of base mana 40 yd range Channeled (5 sec cast) 3 min cooldown Requires Priest Heals all party or raid members within 40 yards for [5 * (560.88% of Spell Power)] over 5 sec. Each heal increases all targets' healing taken by 4% for 15 sec, stacking. Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.

spell_name: Keep Your Feet on the Ground
wowhead_description: Keep Your Feet on the Ground Talent Requires Warrior Physical damage taken reduced by 2%. Thunder Blast reduces damage you take by 8% for 5 sec. (100ms cooldown)
Storm Shield Talent Requires Warrior Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.
Powerful Enrage Talent Requires Warrior Enrage increases your mastery by 15% and your Leech by 3%.
Earthquaker Talent Requires Warrior Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

Veteran Vitality Talent Requires Warrior When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec. (1m cooldown)
Arterial Bleed Talent Requires Warrior Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.

Slayer's Dominance Talent Requires Warrior Your attacks against your primary target have a 15% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing (600.3% of Attack Power) Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap. (500ms cooldown)

Imminent Demise Talent Requires Warrior Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death. Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged. Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm.
Death Drive Talent Requires Warrior You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.
Show No Mercy Talent Requires Warrior Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.
Overwhelming Blades Talent Requires Warrior Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1 % for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.

Fierce Followthrough Talent Requires Warrior Fury Bloodthirst critical strikes increase the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 20%. Arms Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.

Opportunist Talent Requires Warrior Arms When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 10% additional damage and 10% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times. Fury When Raging Blow resets its own cooldown, your next Raging Blow deals 10% additional damage and 10% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.

Reap the Storm Talent Requires Warrior Fury Bloodthirst has a 20% chance to cause you to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for (593.776% of Attack Power) Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. Arms Mortal Strike and Cleave when it hits 3 or more targets have a 20% chance to cause you to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for (593.776% of Attack Power) Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets. (500ms cooldown)
Relentless Pursuit Talent Requires Warrior Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec. Charge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.
Vicious Agility Talent Requires Warrior Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.
Culling Cyclone Talent Requires Warrior Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.
Slayer's Malice Talent Requires Warrior Arms Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%. Fury Raging Blow and Execute damage increased by 15%.

Unrelenting Onslaught Talent Requires Warrior Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have. You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.
Brutal Finish Talent Requires Warrior Arms Your next Mortal Strike after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage. Fury Your next Rampage after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage.
Fight Through the Flames Talent Requires Warrior Defensive Stance additionally reduces magic damage you take by 4%.
Snap Induction Talent Requires Warrior Protection Activating Demoralizing Shout grants a charge of Thunder Blast. Fury Activating Recklessness grants a charge of Thunder Blast. (100ms cooldown)
Armor Specialization Talent Requires Warrior Armor increased by 6%.
Hunker Down Talent Requires Warrior Damage you take from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%. Spell Reflection reduces magic damage taken by an additional 10%.
Spellbreaker Talent Requires Warrior You have a 8% chance to disrupt magic damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 50%.
Unyielding Stance Talent Requires Warrior Defensive Stance reduces damage taken by an additional 4%.
Heavy Handed Talent Requires Warrior Execute hits up to 2 additional targets for 70% damage.
Whirling Blade Talent Requires Warrior Approximately 5 procs per minute Your attacks have a chance to target a nearby enemy with Ravager for 4 sec.
Last Stand Talent Requires Warrior Activating Shield Wall increases your maximum health by 30% for 8 sec and instantly heals you for that amount.
Resonant Voice Talent Requires Warrior The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.

Interpose Talent 25 yd range Instant 30 sec cooldown 1 Charge Requires Warrior Run at high speed toward a target location near your allies, taking 30% of all damage dealt to allies within 3 yards for 8 sec or until you take at least [(0.2) * Total Health] damage from this effect.
Brute Force Talent Requires Warrior Slam has a 10% increased chance to trigger Tactician.
Efficiency Talent Requires Warrior Slam's Rage cost is reduced by 25%.
Just Warming Up Talent Requires Warrior Colossus Smash generates 15 Rage.
Broad Strokes Talent Requires Warrior Colossus Smash grants you Sweeping Strikes.
Powerful Momentum Talent Requires Warrior Secondary targets take an additional 25% damage from Sweeping Strikes.
Tactical Edge Talent Requires Warrior Colossus Smash causes your next 2 Mortal Strikes to have a 100% chance to trigger Tactician.
Crushing Combo Talent Requires Warrior Colossus Smash causes your next 3 Cleaves within 20 sec to trigger no cooldown.
Master Tactician Talent Requires Warrior Tactician has a 5% increased chance to trigger.

Deep Wounds Talent Requires Warrior Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target. Deep Wounds Causes the target to suffer (145.48% of Attack Power) Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

Mortal Wounds Talent Requires Warrior Mortal Strike and Cleave critical strikes inflict Deep Wounds. Deep Wounds Causes the target to suffer (145.48% of Attack Power) Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.
Devastating Focus Talent Requires Warrior You focus on the target struck by your Devastator, dealing 30% additional Revenge damage to them. Only one target can have your focus at a time.
Scent of Blood Talent Requires Warrior Rampage increases the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 10%, stacking up to 2 times. (500ms cooldown)
Ragedrinker Talent Requires Warrior Bloodthirst critical strikes restore 3% additional health and increase the damage of Raging Blow by 10% for 4 sec. (500ms cooldown)

Rampaging Ruin Talent Requires Warrior While Improved Whirlwind is active Rampage instead strikes all targets in front of you for [(135.377% of Attack Power) + (78.9703% of Attack Power) + (180.505% of Attack Power) + (101.533% of Attack Power)] Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
Surge of Adrenaline Talent Requires Warrior When Raging Blow resets its own cooldown, your auto-attack damage and speed is increased by 30% for 6 sec.

Kill or Be Killed Talent Requires Warrior When you would sustain fatal damage, you instead fly into an unstoppable rage, becoming unkillable and immune to movement-impairing effects for 8 sec as you seek revenge on your would-be killer. If you kill your killer in that time, you emerge from your blind rage triumphant, with at least 20% of your max health intact. If you are not victorious, you die. This effect can only occur once every 5 min and if your killer is alive when you sustain fatal damage.
Executioner's Wrath Talent Requires Warrior Execute generates 5 additional Rage and increases the damage of Rampage by 10% for 4 sec.
Master of Warfare Talent Requires Warrior Each stack of Master of Warfare increases Mortal Strike, Cleave, and Overpower damage by 2.5% and critical strike damage by 2.5%.
Master of Warfare Talent Requires Warrior Heroic Strike increases the damage you deal to enemies affected by your next Colossus Smash by an additional 3.0%. Stacks up to 5 times.

Rampaging Berserker Talent Requires Warrior Rampage damage increased by 10% and Rampage makes you go Berserk, increasing your Strength by 3% for 8 sec. Multiple applications of Berserk may overlap. (500ms cooldown)
Rampaging Berserker Talent Requires Warrior Rampage's Rage cost is reduced by 15 and damage is increased by a further 5% during Recklessness.
Rampaging Berserker Talent Requires Warrior Recklessness grants 3 stacks of Berserk and duration of Recklessness increased by 50%.

Phalanx Talent Requires Warrior Thunder Clap causes your next Shield Slam to deal 10% additional damage and unleash a wave of force, dealing (198% of Attack Power) Physical damage to all enemies in front of you.
Phalanx Talent Requires Warrior Damage dealt by Thunder Clap and Phalanx's wave of force is increased by 10%.

Phalanx Talent Requires Warrior While Shield Block is active, Shield Slam deals 10% additional damage and has a 20% increased chance to critically strike. Enemies damaged by Phalanx's wave of force deal 5% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.

Master of Warfare Talent Requires Warrior Your single target melee abilities have a chance to upgrade Slam to Heroic Strike. All modifiers and talents that affect Slam also affect Heroic Strike. Heroic Strike 20 Rage Melee Range Instant Requires Warrior Requires level 1 Requires Melee Weapon Powerfully strike an opponent, causing (600% of Attack Power) Physical damage and gaining a stack of Master of Warfare, allowing your attacks to penetrate 3% armor for 30 sec. Multiple applications of this effect may overlap. (100ms cooldown)
Decimator Talent Requires Warrior Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets, at 100% effectiveness.

Cut to the Bone Talent Requires Warrior Arms Mortal Strike critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec. Protection Shield Slam critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec. (500ms cooldown)

Celeritous Conclusion Talent Requires Warrior Arms Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Mortal Strike by 100%. Protection Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Shield Slam by 100%.
Violent Euphoria Talent Requires Warrior Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.
Deadly Focus Talent Requires Warrior Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.
Conductivity Talent Requires Warrior Lightning Strike damage increased by 10% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.
Capacitance Talent Requires Warrior During Avatar, Thunder Blast extends Avatar's duration by 2.0 sec.
Fearless Talent Requires Warrior Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.
Field Dressing Talent Requires Warrior Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.

Javelineer Talent Requires Warrior Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards. Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%. Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.
Martial Prowess Talent Requires Warrior Overpower and Slam increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 5%, stacking up to 3 times. (500ms cooldown)
Mass Execution Talent Requires Warrior Cleave and Whirlwind deal 20% additional damage to targets below 35% health.
Ignore Pain Talent Instant 20 sec cooldown Requires Warrior Fight through the pain, ignoring 50% of damage taken for 12 sec sec or until [0 * (1 + Versatility)] damage has been prevented.

Stance Mastery Talent Requires Warrior Fury Your stances have additional effects. Berserker Stance Increases your auto-attack speed by 3%. Defensive Stance When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%. Arms, Protection Your stances have additional effects. Battle Stance Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%. Defensive Stance When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.
